item.title: Postgres 19's Graph Queries Were Reverted Four Days Before Release
item.description: SQL/PGQ shipped in the PostgreSQL 19 betas and was reverted four days after the article everyone was sharing ran it against a Neo4j workload. I followed the commit and the mailing list thread, and here is what survived.
